# Bridge Craftwork

> Free, open-source tools for contract bridge players and teachers, at
> bridge-craftwork.com. Each tool runs in the browser at its own path, and
> most are also command-line programs.

Each tool below publishes a plain-text reference beside it, generated from the
same source its page runs on, so it describes exactly what the tool accepts.
Read it before writing input for the tool. A tool with no reference yet is not
listed here.

## Tools

- [dealer3 language reference](https://bridge-craftwork.com/dealer3/reference.txt):
  every statement, function and operator of the dealer script language, for
  generating bridge deals. The tool: https://bridge-craftwork.com/dealer3/
- [rusty-bidding-bot reference](https://bridge-craftwork.com/rusty-bidding-bot/reference.txt):
  a rule-based engine that bids all four hands, its inputs, parameters and
  window.rustyBiddingBot. The tool: https://bridge-craftwork.com/rusty-bidding-bot/
- [Convention card reference](https://bridge-craftwork.com/card/reference.txt):
  every field a convention card can hold, every convention it can name, and
  window.card. The editor: https://bridge-craftwork.com/card/

## Docs

- [Convention card](https://bridge-craftwork.com/docs/card/): using the editor.

## Source

- [bridge-craftwork on GitHub](https://github.com/bridge-craftwork)
